d: A spectral entity draped in a flowing, oversized white sheet that covers the entire body and head, featuring two small, hollow black circular holes for eyes. The entity has a slender build, with pale skin visible at the ankles and a glimpse of a reddish-orange tentacle emerging from beneath the fabric. The outfit is solely the white draped cloth, worn over red high-heeled shoes adorned with a light-blue starfish accessory. BODY COLOR: White and pale skin
